q1_issues.issue: The consequent's Skolem terms (sk_turn $s) and (sk_residue $s) are keyed only to the theme $s, not to the trigger occurrence $g, so two gatherings of the same salt-bloom would collapse onto one turn event (also making it During two triggers) — the instruction set makes a dependent existential a function of every universal that scopes over it, and its whenever template keys the consequent on the trigger event variable.

q2_gaps: "at the full moon" — a definite NP naming a recurring natural/astronomical phase used as a temporal adjunct: the Time section supplies structured calendar/clock terms, speech-anchored deictic constants, and day-part constants (morning/dawn/noon/dusk/night), but nothing covering this, and it does not say whether such a symbol is a bare Time constant (as the parse takes it) or an ordinary event-noun entity like "the storm", nor whether a compound time symbol owes decomposition atoms the way room_temperature does
notes: The change-of-kind result is encoded exactly as the instruction set's turn-into pattern (subject as Patient, result state reified on the same subject via Experiencer, flat copular atom, Result link, no spatial Goal), and the "that salt-bloom" anaphor correctly binds the premise variable. Fusing chalky_residue rather than splitting the descriptive adjective is borderline against the incidental-description bar, but both decomposition atoms are emitted so the two readings are information-equivalent.
